title: Can the govt take control of foreign-funded assets? FCRA Bill explained

title: US removed 100 outdated dams, setting a new river restoration record

The projects reopened fish habitats, improved river connectivity and addressed public safety concerns. Pennsylvania led with 14 removals, followed by Massachusetts with 11 and Vermont with nine.

title: 12,900-year-old cave reveals forgotten hunter-gatherer world in Türkiye
content: The Koskarlı Cave in Türkiye has unveiled a remarkable 12,900-year-old layer showcasing the life of hunter-gatherers. This extraordinary find includes evidence of Epipalaeolithic individuals, featuring items like a hearth, stone tools, and personal ornaments. Importantly, these discoveries hint at cultural links between regions such as Anatolia, the Caucasus, and the Levant, paving the way for deeper insights into prehistoric societies.

title: Air turbulence: That sudden stomach-drop feeling; why the body reacts before the brain
